proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Our Fan rowhouse was painted four years ago and was already peeling at every sill. Theo showed us the old paint had gone straight over dirt. His crew spent three full days washing, scraping and priming before any color went on. Two summers later the sills still look new.
reviews.name: Allison R.

reviews.text: The house was built in 1924 and we have a toddler. They tested first, hung plastic around the porch, wet-scraped everything and vacuumed the beds at the end of each day. I never once found paint chips in the yard.
reviews.name: Kwame O.

reviews.text: Three bedrooms and a hall. They texted the night before, covered every floor and moved the dresser back exactly where it was. The line between the white ceiling and the blue wall is perfectly straight.
reviews.name: Diane F.

reviews.text: They found two rotten column bases on our porch, sent photos and a price before fixing them, and the number on the final invoice matched. The porch floor is gray again instead of bare wood.
reviews.name: Samuel T.

reviews.text: Kitchen cabinets went from orange oak to a soft white. They took the doors to their shop and sprayed them, so there are no brush marks. A year in, no chips around the handles.
reviews.name: Laura M.

reviews.text: The written schedule told us which day they would wash, which day they would prime, and when the second coat would go on. It rained on day three and they moved everything one day and told us why.
reviews.name: Peter H.

proof.guarantee: If paint we applied peels or blisters within two years, we come back and fix that area.
